title: Bound an attack-simulation operation
description: Choose the learning objective, target boundary, approval mode, and number of linked technique steps. The model updates host exposure, execution waves, evidence work, and the review decision together.

objectives.label: Verify one telemetry source
objectives.detail: Prove that a bounded behavior creates the expected endpoint or network observation.

objectives.label: Validate a correlated detection
objectives.detail: Link several behaviors and verify ground truth, telemetry, analytics, and alert context.

objectives.label: Rehearse detection and response
objectives.detail: Exercise a longer chain through alert acknowledgement, containment, and evidence review.

environments.label: Dedicated lab group
environments.detail: Two disposable hosts with isolated identities, data, and network access.

environments.label: Production canary group
environments.detail: Five pre-approved hosts representing one production workload segment.

environments.label: Broad production segment
environments.detail: Twenty-four hosts across several teams and failure domains.

approvalModes.label: Approve every host-action
approvalModes.detail: One host runs one reviewed step before the operator continues.

approvalModes.label: Approve each execution wave
approvalModes.detail: Two hosts may run in parallel, then the operator reviews evidence and cleanup.

approvalModes.label: Bounded autonomous run
approvalModes.detail: Up to five approved hosts proceed without a per-wave human gate.
